user.title: Connect to MowDeck
user.description: Enter the address of your MowDeck installation and an API token created in the MowDeck app (Settings, API tokens) with the permissions mower.view and mower.control. Grant mower.view on the whole account to receive MowDeck notifications.

data_description.url: Base URL of the MowDeck web app, for example {example_url}
data_description.api_token: The token is shown only once when it is created.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew the MowDeck API token
reauth_confirm.description: The API token for {url} was revoked or has expired. Create a new token in the MowDeck app and enter it here.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure MowDeck
reconfigure.description: Change the address of your MowDeck installation, for example after it moved. Enter a new API token only if you want to replace the current one; it must belong to the same MowDeck account.

data_description.url: Base URL of the MowDeck web app, for example {example_url}
data_description.api_token: Optional. Leave empty to keep the current token.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach MowDeck at this URL.
error.invalid_auth: The API token is invalid, expired or revoked.
error.invalid_url: Enter an http or https URL.
error.missing_permission: The API token lacks the permission mower.view.
error.no_account: This token belongs to no MowDeck account.

abort.already_configured: This MowDeck account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: The new token belongs to another MowDeck account.

data_description.poll_interval: Seconds between API polls while the live connection is down.
data_description.expose_emergency_stop: Adds an emergency stop button per mower. The action mowdeck.emergency_stop is always available.
data_description.persistent_notifications: Also show MowDeck notifications of this severity or higher as persistent notifications in Home Assistant. The event entities and the mowdeck_notification event get every notification regardless.

command_forbidden.message: The API token may not send {command}. Grant {permission} to the token in the MowDeck app.

camera_relay_unsupported.message: MowDeck's camera relay cannot serve this mower. Enable the camera relay (and for Mammotion mowers the Agora bridge) in MowDeck

camera_unsupported.message: This mower has no camera MowDeck can show

camera_budget.message: A camera limit of the mower refused the stream (video budget or battery)

camera_forbidden.message: MowDeck refused the camera: the plan does not include the camera, or the API token lacks mower.view

camera_not_found.message: The mower is not visible to the API token

camera_unavailable.message: The camera is not reachable right now: MowDeck, its camera relay or the mower did not answer

camera_failed.message: The camera could not be started, see the log

camera_refused.message: MowDeck's media server refused the stream

camera_missing.message: The mower does not offer this camera in the current session

camera_starting_timeout.message: The mower's camera did not start in time. Try again in a moment

camera_lease_lost.message: The camera stream ended on the MowDeck side. Open the camera again

action_forbidden.message: The API token may not run {command}. Grant {permission} to the token in the MowDeck app.

no_area_selected.message: No area is selected. Turn on at least one area switch or choose an area.

no_map.message: MowDeck has no map of this mower yet.

realtime_unauthorized.title: MowDeck live updates are refused
realtime_unauthorized.description: MowDeck at {url} refuses the live connection even with a fresh access token, so Home Assistant only polls every few minutes. Check that the API token still exists and has the permission mower.view, or create a new token and enter it with Reconfigure on the integration. This message disappears as soon as the live connection works again.

health_forbidden.title: MowDeck refuses the mower health data
health_forbidden.description: MowDeck at {url} answers the health totals (blade hours, mowing hours, distance, battery cycles) with "forbidden" for this API token, so these sensors are unavailable. Grant the permission {permission} to the token in the MowDeck app. This message disappears with the next successful update.

scheduler_forbidden.title: MowDeck refuses the schedules
scheduler_forbidden.description: MowDeck at {url} answers the schedules or the rain decision with "forbidden" for this API token, so the schedule and rain entities are unavailable. Grant the permission {permission} (it follows mower.view) to the token in the MowDeck app. This message disappears with the next successful update.

ble_bridge_outdated.title: The Bluetooth bridge of {mower} needs a firmware update
ble_bridge_outdated.description: MowDeck reports that the Bluetooth bridge of {mower} runs firmware older than MowDeck expects (reason: {reason}; ESPHome {esphome_version}, MowDeck bridge template {project_version}). Driving and spot runs over the bridge may fail until it is updated. Build and flash the bridge again from the current MowDeck bridge template (see the mower page in MowDeck). This message disappears once the bridge reports current firmware.

missing_permission_notifications.title: The MowDeck API token receives no notifications
missing_permission_notifications.description: The API token lacks the permission {permission}, so MowDeck pushes no notifications to Home Assistant and the notification entities stay silent. Grant mower.view on the whole account (not a site, group or mower) to the token at {url}. A token created before MowDeck 0.7.0 must be issued again with the same grants; enter the new token with Reconfigure on the integration. This message disappears once the token holds {permission} (checked every 10 minutes).

start_mow.name: Start mowing areas
start_mow.description: Starts a mowing job on one or more map areas, optionally with pattern settings.

area_ids.name: Area IDs
area_ids.description: Map area ids in mowing order. Default: the area chosen in the Area select, or all areas.

pattern.name: Pattern
pattern.description: Pattern settings, validated by MowDeck against the pattern's JSON Schema.

emergency_stop.name: Emergency stop
emergency_stop.description: Stops the mower and its blades at once.

set_speed.name: Set mowing speed
set_speed.description: Sets the driving speed while mowing.

get_map.name: Get map
get_map.description: Returns the mower's current map (areas with MowDeck's names, paths, no-go zones, dock) in the local frame of its geo reference.

get_heatmap.name: Get heatmap
get_heatmap.description: Returns a heatmap layer of the mower over its map: coverage with missed spots, RTK fix share, or Wi-Fi or mobile signal.

layer.name: Layer
layer.description: coverage, rtk, wifi or mnet (mobile network).

start.name: Start
start.description: Start of the time range. Default: 7 days ago.

end.name: End
end.description: End of the time range. Default: now.
